en.people.pi.name: Dr. Qin Wu
en.people.pi.bio1: Qin Wu is a Principal Investigator and Ph.D. Supervisor at the Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Head of the Research Group. She serves as Chief Scientist of a CAS Strategic Priority Research Program, Deputy Director of the Center for Nucleic Acid Molecular Medicine, and Vice Dean of the Innovation Research Institute. She is a recipient of the National Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas), the Zhejiang Provincial Distinguished Young Scientists Fund, and is recognized as a Zhejiang High-Level Overseas Talent (Long-term Innovation Program).
en.people.pi.bio2: Her research group integrates chemical biology, cell biology, molecular biology, and bioinformatics to construct single-cell spatiotemporal molecular maps of tumors. The team aims to identify novel therapeutic targets, elucidate the molecular mechanisms underlying tumor initiation and progression, discover predictive biomarkers of drug response, and develop innovative therapeutic strategies to enable personalized precision medicine. In the past two years, as corresponding author, she has published multiple papers in leading journals including Nature Chemical Biology, Nature Communications, Cell Chemical Biology, and Advanced Science, and has been granted several patents. She currently leads multiple national and provincial research projects, including grants from the National Natural Science Foundation of China and key R&D programs of the Ministry of Science and Technology and Zhejiang Province.

zh.people.pi.name: 吴芩研究员
zh.people.pi.bio1: 吴芩，中国科学院杭州医学研究所研究员、博士生导师、课题组长。现任中国科学院战略性先导科技专项首席科学家、核酸分子医学研究中心副主任、创新研究院副院长。入选国家优秀青年科学基金（海外）、浙江省杰出青年基金，并获评浙江省海外高层次人才长期创新项目。
zh.people.pi.bio2: 课题组综合运用化学生物学、细胞生物学、分子生物学和生物信息学等方法，构建肿瘤单细胞时空分子图谱，识别新的治疗靶点，解析肿瘤发生发展的分子机制，发现药物疗效预测生物标志物，并发展创新治疗策略以实现个体化精准医疗。近两年，吴芩老师作为通讯作者在 Nature Chemical Biology、Nature Communications、Cell Chemical Biology、Advanced Science 等期刊发表多篇论文，并获授权多项专利；目前主持国家自然科学基金、科技部重点研发计划和浙江省重点研发项目等多项国家及省部级课题。
